Title: Impact of Pre-training on Inference Latency

Abstract: We evaluate model latency across workloads.

1. Introduction
Large language models require extensive evaluation. As detailed in Table 1, our benchmark spans multiple parameter scales.

2. Methodology
We measure memory throughput. The formal latency relationship is given in Equation 1.

3. Results
Figure 1 illustrates the comparative speedups across GPUs. Table 2 details the token throughput rates.

4. Discussion
Section 2 highlighted the architectural limitations.
